mentions.name: Audio Drama Studio (Mahabharata)
mentions.description: An audio drama studio that publishes audio dramas, starting with an adaptation of the Mahabharata, exploring its morally grey treatment of the concept of Dharma.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on building an audio drama studio, publishing audio dramas starting with the Mahabharata. As an Indian, I have always been fascinated with the concept of `Dharma` and the Mahabharata treats it as a very grey area morally.
